environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x runtime) triggered by S3 PutObject events. The Lambda execution role has AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess, AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess, and AmazonSNSFullAccess managed policies attached. The function runs in a VPC with NAT gateway providing unrestricted outbound internet access. No permission boundary is attached to the Lambda execution role. The S3 bucket accepts uploads from authenticated users via a presigned URL endpoint. exiftool binary is bundled in a Lambda layer at /opt/bin/exiftool.
